description: This file declares the LogFileHandle class used for managing log file handles within the firebolt::rialto::logging namespace. It provides methods for singleton access, initialization with a file path, and querying the file descriptor and open status.

classes.name: LogFileHandle
classes.description: A singleton class that manages a file handle for logging purposes, providing initialization and status query methods.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of LogFileHandle.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the log file handle with the specified file path.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor associated with the log file.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the log file is currently open.
